newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 1996 ad pages fall 10.1 percent.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 1996 ad pages fall 10.1 percent.

text.p: Advertising pages in Swiss newspapers fell 10.1 percent in 1996, according to figures compiled by the WEMF media tracking agency.
(pct change in pages vs year-ago) Jan-Dec Dec

Note: The Association of Swiss Advertising Companies (VSW) said the figures tended to overstate the drop. It said a more useful comparison would use the number of pages per editions appearing, which helped reflect an industry consolidation last year. This system showed drops of 6.9 percent among newspapers and 0.6 percent for magazines in 1996.
